company_name: TANAKA PRECIOUS METAL GROUP CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — TANAKA Precious Metals Group is a key supplier of precious metal materials and bonding wires specifically for the semiconductor packaging industry.
summary: TANAKA Precious Metals Group specializes in the manufacture and supply of precious metals and advanced materials for the semiconductor industry, including bonding wires and electroplating materials. With over 140 years of experience, the company plays a crucial role in providing high-reliability packaging solutions for various electronic applications.
capabilities: Gold and copper bonding wires for semiconductor packaging

regional_presence.Japan: Headquartered in Tokyo, TANAKA has a strong presence in the Japanese market, focusing on the semiconductor and electronics industries.
